dogecoin.text: Peter made so much on Dogecoin that we could afford both a dollar sign AND the word “dollars” in that previous tweet. Now THAT’s wealth.

Peter made $75 dollars off of Dogecoin and told us he was leaving to buy a private island, so this weekend, we're revisiting some of our favorite segments from the past few years, including our interviews with @PatinkinMandy and Desus and Mero!
